cues.title: Wild food plants
cues.description: Food-bearing plants grow among the underbrush. Careful gathering may provide supplies for the journey.

cues.title: Fresh game tracks
cues.description: Fresh tracks lead through the wild ground. Following them may provide supplies for the journey.

cues.title: Fresh animal tracks
cues.description: Fresh hoofprints cross the sheltered ground. Following them may yield provisions for the road.

cues.title: Edible plants

cues.title: Abandoned food cache
cues.description: Weathered wrappings lie tucked into a sheltered corner. Some stored provisions may still be usable.
